highlights_headline: The 3.118 previews advance to Skia m118 and improve .NET 9 WebAssembly compatibility.
highlights_body: Android native assets gain 16 KB alignment, and Metal backend render-target APIs become available across platforms.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine through milestones 117 and 118, with matching managed and native bindings.
Fixes .NET 9 Blazor issues, extends the WASM workaround to applications that do not reference Blazor views, and corrects imports when an application uses a base path.
Corrects the PackagePath attribute used to place packaged assets.
Moves Android native builds to NDK r27c and 16 KB page alignment.
Makes the Metal API on GRBackendRenderTarget available across all platforms.
Updates libexpat to 2.6.4 and FreeType to the 2.13.3-based revision, and refreshes the libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5.1-based dependency.

contributor_summaries.spouliot: Metal backend render-target APIs across platforms.

preview_summaries.v3.118.0-preview.1.2: Introduced the Skia m118 engine baseline and the HarfBuzz 8.3.1 dependency update.
preview_summaries.v3.118.0-preview.2.3: Added Android 16 KB alignment and cross-platform Metal render-target APIs, and fixed .NET 9 WebAssembly startup and base-path imports.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp receives Android 16 KB alignment and package-path corrections. WASM workaround changes also cover consumers outside the Blazor views package.
